tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get a page from the company's internal wiki by its page title. Do not use this for a file at a web URL, a PDF on the local disk or a contract by its CT- ID.

tools.name: fetch_document
tools.description: Download a file from a public web address (an http or https URL). Do not use this for a wiki page by title, a PDF on the local disk or a contract by its CT- ID.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a PDF stored on the local disk and return its text. Do not use this for a wiki page by title, a file at a web URL or a contract by its CT- ID.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open a signed contract from the contracts archive by contract ID (format CT-12345). Do not use this for a wiki page by title, a file at a web URL or a PDF on the local disk.
